text:
Type: solid pine wooden stool
Use: extra seating, step, plant stand or side table; dining room, kitchen, bedroom, hallway
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: untreated solid pine with visible knots and grain, metal bolts
Colors: pale natural pine, warm honey
Shape: square seat with an overhanging rounded edge, deep apron, four straight square legs, square stretcher frame halfway down, sturdy and compact
Feel: natural, simple, honest, warm
Goes with: white walls, light wood, linen, woven baskets; rustic, Scandinavian or cabin rooms

product.name: ODDVAR
product.description: Solid wood is a hardwearing natural material, which can be sanded and surface treated as required.
